subject: Re: MERF kickoff — status + mobile trade-off
body:
Status ahead of the June sweep:

- Reproduction: done on all 9 mipnerf360 scenes; we're within 0.15 PSNR of the paper on average, and the baked models match the volumetric ones per the lossless procedure — the bake-vs-train delta is under 0.05 PSNR, as advertised.
- Viewer: Milan has real-time rendering (60+ fps at 1080p) on both desktop test rigs.

Trade-off to settle: mobile. On mid-range phones the memory budget forces us to shrink the sparse feature grid, costing ~0.8 PSNR and dropping to ~24 fps. Options: (a) desktop-only for the LRB demo, (b) ship the degraded mobile profile clearly labeled "preview". Partner-facing folks will ask for mobile; I lean (b) with honest labeling.

Next week's vulcan sweep retrains + bakes everything at final settings; job specs are staged so we start the moment our week opens.

Yara
